article.title: PIMS fire inquiry report finds major safety failures behind deaths of newborns
article.summary: A 43-page inquiry report into the deadly fire at the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) has held the hospital administration responsible for major safety failures that led to the deaths of 14 newborn babies,Aaj Newsreported on Tuesday.According to the report, the fire killed 14 newborns, while one baby was rescued safely. The inquiry committee found that serious fire-safety deficiencies had previously been identified at the hospital, but adequate corrective and preventive measures were not taken.The report said the fire originated from an electrical cable connected to air conditioner No. 2, with a short circuit identified as the likely cause. The National Forensic Agency’s technical findings ruled out the incubators or warmers as the point of origin. The committee also found no evidence of deliberate arson or an oxygen leak.The inquiry found that the 10-bed nursery was overcrowded, with 15 newborns receiving treatment at the time of the incident. article.title: Pims fire: Inquiry committee finds 'systemic, institutional failure' behind tragedy
article.summary: ISLAMABAD: An inquiry committee formed to probe thedeadly fireat the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (Pims) has found “systemic and institutional failure” and determined that an electrical failure was the most likely cause of the blaze, it emerged on Tuesday.The August 26 fire at a nursery in Pims’ Mother and Child Hospital claimed the lives of 14 newborns. The incident raised concerns over fire safetymeasuresand sparkedcalls for accountability, with criminal action being ordered againsteight officials.Headed by former interior secretary Shahid Khan, the committee wasformedon Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif’s directives on the day the fire occurred. article.summary: President Asif Ali Zardari on Wednesday gave his approval for conferring the Tamgha-i-Shujaat on Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (Pims) nurse Razia Noreen, who saved the life of a newborn during afireat the facility that killed 14 infants.The announcement was made by the Presidency.
